chapter: New Orleans clarinetists and learning the guitar
title: Playing tuba in the Gibson brass band today
summary: Old-timers he knew; now plays tuba with the Gibson brass band among old and young men.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You're still working when you run to work. You're still working with the Gibson band anyway.

Well, you see, well I'm working with old men and young men too. Yeah. But of course I didn't know the young fellas coming up now these days in time. I happen to be with the Gibson brass band now playing tubo with them. And the whole thing is I didn't know them when I first went there. But of course after taking and started playing with them a little while, the young ones like them as well as the old ones. Yeah. Of course I understand they got good and bad in all ways, you know. Sometime when they make a bus, well you got to try to cover that bus up.

See, the young ones make it, not the old ones can't make it. Yeah. Well of course the old ones make buses, while the young ones make it. Well that ought to be that they ought to have more of a better education now than, and more of a mother wit than what the older times, because they never had. You see in them days in time, Mr. Russel, in them days in time, we had the guests. We had the, we never had the teachers that they got today. Now today is the day you can get a teacher every minute in the day. You got teachers to learn you. But we just had to pick it up from the man above. God of mine to get a gift.
